items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, a great guitarist. Thigpen on drums, Ed Thigpen's father.

ctx.x: That's right, John Williams was in that Andy Kirk band, and Floyd Smith was on the guitar.
Oh, a great guitarist. Thigpen on drums, Ed Thigpen's father.
And Ben on drums. Oh, Andy Kirk had a great band. I can't think of his trombone player's name, I think it was Russell Bowells, but Russell Bowells was with Jimmy Lunceford.
